summary: Planban 1.1.5 repairs first-launch dependency installation on Windows, aligns board and MCP runtime discovery, and updates dependencies with security fixes.
updatePrompt: Update Planban from piercekearns/planban. Verify version 1.1.5, the installed plugin, and MCP tools; open an existing Board and confirm it remains readable and writable. This release changes dependencies, so a clean dependency install is expected. Reinstall the plugin after refreshing the marketplace so cached MCP startup metadata is updated.
changelogSummary: Reliable first launches, consistent board and MCP startup, and dependency security updates.
